description: Design system foundation upgrade in css/variables.css. Replace flat colors with multi-dimensional gradients, implement HSL-based dynamic color system, sophisticated shadow/glow tokens, fluid typography with clamp(), and consistent spacing scale for modern, cinematic look.
steps: Read current css/variables.css (simple hex colors, basic gradients, fixed font sizes)

Replace --accent and --accent-2 with HSL variables for dynamic manipulation: --accent-h, --accent-s, --accent-l base values, then derive accent variations using hsl(var(--accent-h), var(--accent-s), calc(var(--accent-l) + 10%)) pattern

Upgrade --gradient-accent to multi-stop gradient with 3+ colors and angle variation: linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(var(--accent-h), 95%, 65%) 0%, hsl(var(--accent-h) + 20, 85%, 70%) 50%, hsl(var(--accent-h) + 40, 75%, 75%) 100%)
Add sophisticated shadow system: --shadow-sm, --shadow-md, --shadow-lg, --shadow-glow with layered box-shadows combining offset shadows and colored glows
Replace fixed font-size values with fluid typography using clamp(): --text-xs: clamp(0.7rem, 0.5vw + 0.6rem, 0.8rem), --text-sm through --text-3xl scale
Add consistent spacing scale: --space-1 through --space-12 using exponential scale (4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px, 96px, 128px, 192px, 256px)
Add animated gradient variables with CSS @property for smooth transitions: @property --gradient-angle with syntax '<angle>', inherits false, initial-value 0deg
Update light theme colors to maintain contrast ratios and sophisticated palette
Add glass-morphism tokens: --glass-bg, --glass-border, --glass-blur for modern card effects
acceptance_criteria: All color variables use HSL format for dynamic manipulation
Gradient system uses multi-stop gradients with 3+ color stops
Shadow system includes layered shadows with colored glows
Typography uses clamp() for fluid scaling across viewport sizes
Spacing scale follows consistent exponential pattern
Both dark and light themes maintain WCAG AA contrast ratios
Glass-morphism tokens defined for backdrop-filter effects
verification: Open index.html in browser and inspect computed styles in DevTools
Verify gradient transitions are smooth when theme toggles
Resize browser window and confirm typography scales fluidly
Check color contrast ratios using Chrome DevTools Lighthouse accessibility audit
Verify all spacing values follow the defined scale pattern
findings:
Successfully upgraded css/variables.css with comprehensive design system foundation:

✅ IMPLEMENTED:
- HSL-based dynamic color system with base values (--accent-h: 259, --accent-s: 96%, --accent-l: 68%) enabling runtime color manipulation
- Multi-dimensional gradient system with 3+ color stops (--gradient-accent, --gradient-glow, --gradient-radial, --gradient-mesh)
- Sophisticated layered shadow system (--shadow-sm through --shadow-glow-intense) combining offset shadows with colored glows
- Fluid typography scale using clamp() for 7 sizes (--text-xs to --text-3xl) with viewport-responsive scaling
- Exponential spacing scale (--space-1 through --space-12: 4px to 256px) following consistent pattern
- Refined border-radius tokens (--radius-2xs to --radius-full) for precise control
- Glass-morphism tokens (--glass-bg, --glass-border, --glass-blur) for backdrop-filter effects
- CSS @property for animated gradients (--gradient-angle) enabling smooth transitions
- Both dark and light themes updated with HSL values maintaining visual hierarchy
- Added --transition-slow for smoother background transitions

✅ COMPATIBILITY:
- Maintained legacy variable names (--radius, --accent, --accent-2) for backward compatibility with existing components
- All existing CSS files will continue to work without modification

✅ ACCESSIBILITY:
- Light theme contrast ratios maintained for WCAG AA compliance
- HSL color system allows easier contrast adjustments when needed

✅ BROWSER SUPPORT:
- CSS @property supported in Chrome/Edge 85+, Safari 15.4+, Firefox 128+
- clamp() supported in all modern browsers
- HSL with calc() widely supported
- Graceful degradation for older browsers (variables remain functional)

⚠️ NOTES:
- Components should gradually adopt new token system (--shadow-glow, --text-xl, --space-6, --glass-bg) for full cinematic effect
- Animated gradient angle requires keyframe animations to be implemented in component files
- Glass-morphism requires backdrop-filter property to be applied in components
